scores.evidence: The objectives are unchanged. The changed questions keep their objectiveId: q3 (o2, 「会話だけの指示が要約で落ちた。CLAUDE.mdに書く」), p1 (o1, analyze) and e4 (o2). Every objective still has an inline question and an exam question: o1 has q2, q4, p1–p3 and e1; o2 has q3, e3 and e4; o3 has q1 and e5. Apply and analyze items are present, and e1 and e4 are transfer items.

hook-problem gives a concrete scenario in three sentences (「朝に『テストは `npm test` で実行して』と伝えたのに、午後のClaudeは別のコマンドを試します」) and follows it with the ungraded predict question q0. Each distractor in q0 encodes a misconception (learning, stronger words, a bug). sum-hook answers the same scenario at the end.

Recalls carried over from earlier lessons are unchanged (s1-lead 「第1回で見たコンテキストウィンドウ」, s3-defs （第1回）, s4-defs （第4回）). New terms are defined before use. 「プランモード（plan mode）」 appears in s3-table row 1, in e3 and in card-survive without a recall. 「信頼の確認」 in pr-start is not recalled either.

Measure (this round): 「prose 1945 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 3289 · practice reading 1126 · questions 12 · practice sections 1 · est 19.8 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」. Nothing changed from the previous round. s2-table and s4-table have 2 columns. Strict lint is clean. 5-2 is still dense: /clear, /compact, auto compaction, the focus example and --continue/--resume are all in one segment.

s5-steps is a five-step worked example placed before practice. Each step has a subgoal label and a reason, and it ends in the rewritten prompt s5-prompt. There is no faded step, and ex-learn's 「ずれた行の例」 is still not a concrete condition in s5-prompt.

The questions keep apply/analyze demand and give feedback on every wrong option. The p1 hint 「5-4の表の「パターンと症状」と見比べてみましょう。」 points to the right place without naming the answer. Inline checks appear in every concept section.

Every misconception is covered: more context is better (q2-b, p1-d), reopening empties the session (q2-d, p2-c, p3-d), compaction removes all or nothing (q3-a, q3-c, e3-b, e3-d), stronger words fix it (q0-c, q4-a, e5-a). Feedback stays within two sentences.

s3-diagram has 6 short, wrapped nodes. Its labels match s3-lead (「決まったファイルの指示はディスクから読み直されます」) and the caption 「会話は要約に置き換わり、決まったファイルの指示はディスクから戻る」. s3-table's caption 「図の「決まったファイル」と、そのほかのファイル」 ties the table to the diagram. There are no decorative images.

Re-scored because pr-code changed. The CLAUDE.md rule went from 「- HTMLの<title>は「練習：」で始める」 to 「- titleは「練習：」で始める」. The structure still holds: one command per line, matching pr-start 「上のコマンドを1行ずつ実行します」. Observable expects remain in pr-prompt-a/b, the pr-checklist criteria and pr-answer as a model answer. The hint ladder is still one level deep. But the practice's central evidence is now less reliable. pr-prompt-a expects 「`<title>` は、CLAUDE.mdのとおり「練習：」で始まります」 and pr-prompt-b expects 「about.htmlの `<title>` も「練習：」で始まります」. The rule no longer says it means the HTML <title> element. In a project with index.html, README.md and about.html, 「title」 can also be read as the h1 or the README heading. A learner whose <title> does not start with 「練習：」 could wrongly conclude that CLAUDE.md was not re-read after compaction. That is the opposite of the lesson's point (see mustFix).

The summary comes after the exam. sum-points[2] 「圧縮のあと、直下のCLAUDE.mdや自動メモリはディスクから戻りますが…」 is a takeaway, not a copy of the text. sum-hook, sum-next (a reflection plus the next step to 第6回), 8 flashcards and sum-ask are present.

q3-b, e4-b and sum-points match the audited cc-context-window table (「Project-root CLAUDE.md and unscoped rules | Re-injected from disk」). s3-table row 1 lists the four re-injected items, and row 2 says path-scoped rules come back on demand. Two generic wordings remain: 「ファイルに書いて残します」 in e4-d, and 「いつも守らせたいことはファイルに書きます」 in sum-points[2]. The pr-code change does not affect any factual claim.
です・ます is used throughout. There are no banned phrases. Terms still drift: s2-defs defines 「自動のコンテキスト圧縮」, but e4-b, p2-d and the p2 explanation say 「自動の圧縮」.

The lesson is jp-only and complete. The diagram labels are Japanese, and the diagram has a caption and alt text. The only link has descriptive text. The s3-diagram alt still lists items that the visible diagram no longer shows. s3-table carries the same list.

mustFix.issue: Regression caused by this round's change. The CLAUDE.md rule 「- titleは「練習：」で始める」 no longer says it means the HTML <title> element. Yet pr-prompt-a, pr-prompt-b and pr-answer use that element as the observable proof that CLAUDE.md is re-read after /compact. If Claude reads 「title」 as the h1 or the README heading, the learner's check fails and teaches the opposite conclusion.
mustFix.fix: In pr-code, change the fourth line to: echo '- HTMLのtitleタグは「練習：」で始める' > CLAUDE.md. For consistency, change pr-checklist c-claude-md to 「about.htmlのtitleタグが「練習：」で始まるかを確かめました」 and pr-answer row 1 to 「about.htmlのtitleタグも「練習：」で始まった。圧縮のあと、ディスクから読み直されたため」. Alternatively, restore the previous line 「- HTMLの<title>は「練習：」で始める」.

niceToHave: pr-steps-compact pr-predict hint: s3-diagram no longer names CLAUDE.md. Replace with 「5-3の図と表で、直下のCLAUDE.mdと会話だけの指示がたどる道を見比べます。」.
s3-diagram alt: make it read 「圧縮の前のコンテキストが、会話とツールの出力、決まったファイルの指示の2つに分かれる図。会話は要約に置き換わり、決まったファイルの指示はディスクから読み直されて、どちらも圧縮のあとのコンテキストに入る。中身の一覧は次の表にあります。」.
Term consistency with s2-defs: write 「自動のコンテキスト圧縮」 instead of 「自動の圧縮」 in check-quiz e4 option b feedback, pr-diagnose p2 option d feedback and the p2 explanation.

factual doubt (residual generic wording): check-quiz e4 option d feedback 「決まりはファイルに書いて残します。」 → 「決まりは直下のCLAUDE.mdに書いて残します。」; sum-points[2] last sentence 「いつも守らせたいことはファイルに書きます。」 → 「いつも守らせたいことは直下のCLAUDE.mdに書きます。」.

s5-prompt: ex-learn promises three conditions, but the prompt fills in only two. Replace the third line with 「前に試したときは、{{ずれた行の例}} の日付が1日ずれました。」 and add var {"name": "ずれた行の例", "hint": "例：2026-10-20,1200 の行"}.
プランモード has no recall. In s3-table row 1, write 「プランモード（plan mode、第3回）の計画」.
e4 applies o2 in a new team setting. Set its bloom to "apply" so that o2 also has an apply-level item.
5-2 holds two ideas (choosing /clear or /compact, and reopening a session). Consider moving s2-session and s2-code into 5-1 after s1-defs.
pr-steps-start pr-start expect: 「初めてのフォルダなので、フォルダを信頼するかの確認（第1回）が出ます。承認すると、Claude Codeの入力欄が表示されます。」.
summary: Verification round: review-scope exited 0, with 1 of 47 blocks changed (pr-code, 2%) and no section or objective changes. The previous review had no open must-fix items, so resolved is empty. pr-code was reviewed in full and practice was re-scored. The edit shortened the CLAUDE.md rule to 「titleは「練習：」で始める」. It no longer says it means the HTML <title> element, which pr-prompt-a/b and pr-answer use as the proof that CLAUDE.md is re-read after compaction. This regression is a must-fix, with an exact replacement line. Validate and lint --strict are clean. Measure: prose 1945, est 19.8 min against estMinutes 20. All criteria stay at 3 or above (mean 3.46). The verdict is revise only because of the pr-code regression.
